AI can support workers by helping to power automation, but it's always intended to work in conjunction with human labor. AI augmentation can also help workers to more easily identify and prioritize tasks by quickly sifting through potential tasks and recommending what action should be taken next. AI is meant to enhance the capabilities of human workers, not replace them.
